enumDescriptions: Compile locally with the Dataform CLI (default)
[beta] Remote mode: compile the pushed commit of the current branch with the Dataform API. The Dataform CLI is not needed
vscode-dataform-tools.compilationBackend.markdownDescription: **[beta]** Where the Dataform project is compiled. `api` (remote mode) compiles the **pushed** commit of the current git branch with the Dataform API, so the Dataform CLI does not need to be installed. Results are cached per commit; run `Dataform: Compile using API` or click the status bar item to recompile. Runs also go through the API, and `Run all tests` is unavailable.

vscode-dataform-tools.defaultBranch.markdownDescription: Default git branch that **Run Changed** in the compiled query panel compares against. Uses `origin/<branch>` when it exists, otherwise the local branch, and diffs against its merge-base with your branch. Nothing is fetched automatically.

vscode-dataform-tools.compilerOptions.markdownDescription: Addition compiler options to pass to dataform cli commands e.g. --vars=someKey=someValue,a=b

vscode-dataform-tools.deferToProd.markdownDescription: Defer to prod, like dbt's `--defer`: when an upstream table has not been built in dev, dry runs, previews and the compiled query read it from prod instead, and runs read it through a labelled proxy view created in dev. The prod table comes from compiling with `#vscode-dataform-tools.prodCompilerOptions#`. Toggle it from the status bar or the compiled query panel.

vscode-dataform-tools.prodCompilerOption.markdownDescription: Compiler options that point at your prod tables, used by `#vscode-dataform-tools.deferToProd#`, e.g. `--default-database=my-prod-project --vars=env=prod`. When empty, prod is the project defaults compiled without `#vscode-dataform-tools.compilerOptions#`.

vscode-dataform-tools.deferPreviewScanWa.markdownDescription: Ask before running a preview that reads upstream tables from prod and scans more than this many GiB. `0` turns the check off.

vscode-dataform-tools.deferToProdEditorH.markdownDescription: Show a coloured label after each `${ref(...)}` in .sqlx files that defer to prod reads from prod (`→ deferred to prod`) or from dev because it is built there (`✓ dev · built 12 min ago`), with a warning when prod may be out of date, nothing is built or a leftover proxy view reads prod. Hover the ref for the dev and prod tables and a link to the prod table. Colours: `dataformTools.deferredRef.*`, `dataformTools.builtInDevRef.*` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`.

vscode-dataform-tools.currencyFoDryRunCo.markdownDescription: Supported currencies for Dry Run cost estimation. Choose from USD (US Dollar), EUR (Euro), GBP (British Pound), JPY (Japanese Yen), CAD (Canadian Dollar), AUD (Australian Dollar), or INR (Indian Rupee).

vscode-dataform-tools.showCompiledQueryI.markdownDescription: Shows compiled sql query on veritcal split when `.sqlx` file is saved

vscode-dataform-tools.showAssertionsInDe.markdownDescription: Show assertion actions when the dependency graph opens. Use the graph's **Show assertions** checkbox to switch for the current panel. When hidden, dependencies that run through an assertion are drawn as dashed edges.

vscode-dataform-tools.configBlockDiagnos.markdownDescription: Show warnings in `.sqlx` `config {}` blocks for unknown options, options that don't apply to the action `type`, and invalid values, as you type

vscode-dataform-tools.defaultDataformCom.markdownDescription: Duration to allow project compilation to complete. Use format like '5m', '60s' etc. Passed to `dataform compile --json --timeout=<value>`

vscode-dataform-tools.persistCompilation.markdownDescription: Save the last Dataform CLI compilation of the project and show it as soon as VS Code starts, instead of waiting for `dataform compile`. It is reused only while `definitions/`, `includes/`, the project settings and package files, the Dataform CLI, `compilerOptions` and the day are unchanged. Otherwise it is shown as outdated while the project recompiles in the background, and runs, dry runs and cost estimates wait for the fresh compilation. Output that depends on something else, such as the time of day, needs a recompile: save any Dataform file.

vscode-dataform-tools.executionTimeout.markdownDescription:
Wall-clock deadline for an entire `dataform run` (compilation plus all actions). When it fires, in-flight actions are cancelled and pending actions are skipped. Use format like '10m', '2h' etc. Passed to `dataform run --execution-timeout=<value>`. Leave empty to disable, which is the Dataform CLI default.

Note: `#vscode-dataform-tools.defaultDataformCompileTime#` only bounds the compilation step, not the run as a whole. Requires Dataform CLI 3.0.66 or later.

vscode-dataform-tools.gitRepoName.markdownDescription: Override the repository name used by the extension. When set, this value is used instead of the name derived from the git remote URL or directory name.

vscode-dataform-tools.formattingCli.markdownDescription: CLI to use for formatting. Choose between `sqlfluff` or `dataform`. NOTE:`dataform` cli does not support formatting individual files. It formats the entire project

vscode-dataform-tools.sqlfluffConfigPath.description: Path to sqlfluff config file. Please make sure your .sqlfluff is compatible with .sqlx files

vscode-dataform-tools.sourceAutoCompleti.markdownDescription: Preferred source autocompletion can be one of `${ref('table_name')}` or `${ref('dataset_name', 'table_name')}` or ${ref({schema:'dataset_name', name:'table_name'})}

vscode-dataform-tools.dataformCliScope.markdownDescription: Dataform installation scope to use. Default to `global` which uses the dataform cli installed in global scope when running `dataform install -g @dataform/cli`. Selecting `local` scope would mean dataform cli installation in your workspace folder in `./node_modules/.bin/dataform` will be used. This is created when `npm install @dataform/cli` is ran from the root of the workspace folder.

vscode-dataform-tools.dataformExecutable.markdownDescription:
**Override path to dataform executable**

⚠️ **Only use this if the extension cannot find dataform automatically**

The extension automatically searches:
- System PATH
- Common tool managers (mise, asdf, nvm, etc.)
- Standard installation locations

Use this setting for:
- **Specific versions** for testing: `/path/to/dataform-v3.0.25`
- **Company-approved versions**: `/opt/company-tools/dataform`
- **Non-standard locations**: Custom installation paths

**Example**: `/usr/local/bin/dataform` or `${HOME}/.local/share/mise/installs/npm-dataform-cli/3.0.26/bin/dataform`

vscode-dataform-tools.gcloudExecutablePa.markdownDescription:
**Override path to gcloud executable**

⚠️ **Only use this if the extension cannot find gcloud automatically**

The extension automatically searches:
- System PATH
- Common tool managers (mise, asdf, etc.)
- Standard gcloud installation locations

Use this setting for:
- **Specific versions** for testing: `/path/to/gcloud-v530.0.0`
- **Company-approved versions**: `/opt/company-tools/gcloud`
- **Non-standard locations**: Custom installation paths

**Example**: `/usr/local/bin/gcloud` or `${HOME}/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gcloud`

vscode-dataform-tools.compileAndDryRunBe.markdownDescription: Disable this to experience faster formatting, especially if you have enabled format on save. `::WARNING::` only turn this on if you are confident that your query compiles without errors. Syntax error in config/pre/post operation blocks termination can result in unexpeted results while formatting

vscode-dataform-tools.recommendErrorLens.markdownDescription: Whether to recommend Error Lens extension to show erorrs inline rather than showing them as swigly lines

vscode-dataform-tools.bigQueryTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout in milliseconds for BigQuery queries (max 1 hour)

vscode-dataform-tools.enableLogging.markdownDescription: Enable debug logging to help troubleshoot issues. Logs will appear in the 'Dataform Tools' output channel.

vscode-dataform-tools.gcpProjectId.markdownDescription: GCP project ID to use for BigQuery queries. When not provided, the project ID will be inferred from your enviroment typically same as `gcloud config list project`

vscode-dataform-tools.gcpLocation.markdownDescription: GCP location to use for BigQuery queries. E.g. US, EU, us-central1, europe-west1. Usually you will not need to set this explicity as the location is picked up dynamically by BigQuery client.

vscode-dataform-tools.serviceAccountJson.markdownDescription: Path to the json file when the service account exsists

vscode-dataform-tools.skipPreOpsInDryRun.markdownDescription: If enabled, pre-operations query will be excluded from the query used for dry run. By default, pre-operations are included. `::WARNING::` any variable used in pre-operations query will not be resolved and will result in an error

vscode-dataform-tools.skipPreOpsInPrevie.markdownDescription: If enabled, the pre-operations (and incremental pre-operations) block is excluded from the query run by `Preview Data` / `Run`. Useful to preview a model's output without executing side effects such as `DELETE`/`MERGE` in `pre_operations`. By default, pre-operations are included.

vscode-dataform-tools.formatOrdering.markdownDescription: Order of blocks when formatting .sqlx files. The config block will always be first. Default order is `js` -> `preOperations` -> `postOperations` -> `sql`.

vscode-dataform-tools.compilationSnoozeM.markdownDescription: Duration in minutes to snooze automatic Dataform compilation when snooze is activated.

scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run check-types && npm run build:webviews && npm run esbuild
scripts.watch: npm run clean && concurrently --raw "npm run check-types -- --watch" "npm run esbuild-watch" "npm run webviews:watch"
scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run check-types && npm run build:webviews && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.prerelease: npm run test && markdownlint-cli2 README.md && standard-version --dry-run
